CustomField.description: The path of this service. Outgoing and incoming services both use it. Outbound: the path is added after the service's address, which is usually the Named Credential named on the API Credential, for example /api/v1/accounts. Inbound: an incoming request reaches this service when its path matches this one. The match ignores upper and lower case, and a * matches any characters. When the paths of several active inbound services match, the longest path wins, and Priority decides between paths of the same length.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Outbound: the path added after the service's address, usually its Named Credential (for example /api/v1/accounts). Inbound: the path an incoming request must match to reach this service; a * matches any characters, and the longest matching path wins.
CustomField.label: Endpoint Path
